text: I like the App's simplicity. however, I don't like it when I lose my streak just bcz I didn't input the data before midnight and it says I have to go Premium. I wanted an app that could use a little widget to show me my "praying the rosary" streak, and sometimes, like today, where I prayed it at like 11:30 pm and only remembered abt the app at midnight, lost my 2 day streak, even though I did it. And I won't go premium, I just think that being able to change yesterday's habit should be free.
author: Catarinaaa
developer_reply: Hi Catarinaaa, thank you for your feedback! I'm glad you enjoy using the app. Sorry about this, I'm trying to balance free features with the premium ones and still figuring out how to do it best. The premium tier allow me to keep improving the app. If you have any idea, please email me at contact.adrienblc@gmail.com. - Adrien
